76: class BoundedPager:
77:     """Demand-first scheduler with explicit in-flight, resident, and GPU leases."""
78: 
79:     def __init__(self, catalog: Callable[[PageKey], PageSpec], limits: Limits,
80:                  *, clock: Callable[[], int] = monotonic_ns):
81:         if not callable(clock):
82:             raise ValueError("monotonic wait clock required")
83:         self.catalog = catalog
84:         self.limits = limits
85:         self.clock = clock
86:         self._clock_time = -1
87:         self.wait_deadlines: dict[PageKey, int] = {}
88:         self.demand_queue: deque[PageKey] = deque()
89:         self.hint_queue: deque[PageKey] = deque()
90:         self.actual_demands: set[PageKey] = set()
91:         self.pending: dict[PageKey, IoTicket] = {}
92:         self.resident: OrderedDict[PageKey, PageSpec] = OrderedDict()
93:         self.hint_resident: set[PageKey] = set()
94:         self.leases: dict[int, Lease] = {}
95:         self.next_ticket = 1
96:         self.next_lease = 1
97:         self.resident_bytes = 0
98:         self.staging_bytes = 0
99:         self.hint_waste_bytes = 0
100:         self.closed = False
101:         self.cancel_draining = False
102:         self.cancelled: set[PageKey] = set()
103: 
104:     def _open(self) -> None:
105:         if self.closed:
106:             raise PagerStop("pager stopped")
107: 
108:     def _accepting_work(self) -> None:
109:         self._open()
110:         if self.cancel_draining:
111:             raise PagerProtocolError("request cancellation still draining")
112: 
113:     def check_waits(self) -> None:
114:         """Cooperative watchdog: caller must poll while blocked, even at IO cap.
115: 
116:         Deadlines start at unresident actual demand, never reset on retries or
117:         unrelated activity. Admission/completion is the relevant progress. A
118:         stopped pager still accepts original IO/GPU drainage callbacks.
119:         """
120:         self._open()
121:         try:
122:             now = self.clock()
123:         except Exception as exc:
124:             try:
125:                 self._stop("demand wait clock unavailable")
126:             except PagerStop as stop:
127:                 raise stop from exc
128:         if type(now) is not int or now < 0 or now < self._clock_time:
129:             self._stop("invalid demand wait clock")
130:         self._clock_time = now
131:         if any(now >= deadline for deadline in self.wait_deadlines.values()):
132:             self._stop("actual demand wait expired")
133: 
134:     def _finish_cancel_if_drained(self) -> None:
135:         if self.cancel_draining and not self.pending and not self.leases:
136:             self.cancel_draining = False
137: 
138:     def _stop(self, reason: str) -> None:
139:         self.cancel_request()
140:         self.closed = True
141:         self._drain_unpinned()
142:         raise PagerStop(reason)
143: 
144:     def stop(self, reason: str) -> None:
145:         self._stop(reason)
146: 
147:     def _drain_unpinned(self) -> None:
148:         for key in list(self.resident):
149:             if not self._pinned(key):
150:                 self.resident_bytes -= self.resident.pop(key).size_bytes
151:                 self.hint_resident.discard(key)
152: 
153:     def _spec(self, key: PageKey) -> PageSpec:
154:         spec = self.catalog(key)
155:         if (spec.key != key or not spec.spans or
156:                 any(type(span.offset) is not int or type(span.length) is not int or
157:                     span.offset < 0 or span.length <= 0 for span in spec.spans)):
158:             raise PagerProtocolError("catalog returned an invalid page")
159:         return spec
160: 
161:     def observe(self, sample: Observation) -> None:
162:         """Stop on sampled pressure; this is not an allocation hard limit."""
163:         self._open()
164:         if type(sample) is not Observation:
165:             self._stop("invalid memory observation")
166:         if (any(type(v) is not int or v < 0 for v in
167:                 (sample.process_bytes, sample.system_headroom_bytes, sample.swap_delta_bytes))
168:                 or type(sample.memory_pressure) is not bool):
169:             self._stop("invalid memory observation")
170:         if (sample.process_bytes > self.limits.process_bytes or
171:                 sample.system_headroom_bytes < self.limits.system_headroom_bytes or
172:                 sample.swap_delta_bytes > 0 or sample.memory_pressure):
173:             self._stop("observed process, headroom, swap, or pressure limit")
174:         self.check_waits()

176:     def demand(self, key: PageKey) -> None:
177:         """Only the actual router or PLE lookup may call this method."""
178:         self._accepting_work()
179:         self.check_waits()
180:         self._spec(key)
181:         if key not in self.actual_demands and len(self.actual_demands) >= self.limits.active_demands:
182:             self._stop("active demand limit exceeded")
183:         self.actual_demands.add(key)
184:         if key not in self.resident:
185:             self.wait_deadlines.setdefault(key, self._clock_time + self.limits.demand_wait_ns)
186:         self.hint_resident.discard(key)
187:         self.cancelled.discard(key)
188:         if key in self.resident or key in self.pending or key in self.demand_queue:
189:             return
190:         try:
191:             self.hint_queue.remove(key)
192:         except ValueError:
193:             pass
194:         self.demand_queue.append(key)
195: 
196:     def hint(self, key: PageKey) -> bool:
197:         self._accepting_work()
198:         self.check_waits()
199:         spec = self._spec(key)
200:         if spec.size_bytes > self.limits.staging_bytes or spec.size_bytes > self.limits.weight_bytes - self.limits.fixed_model_bytes:
201:             return False
202:         if (key in self.actual_demands or key in self.resident or key in self.pending or
203:                 key in self.hint_queue or key in self.demand_queue):
204:             return False
205:         if len(self.hint_queue) >= self.limits.queued_hints:
206:             return False
207:         self.hint_queue.append(key)
208:         return True
209: 
210:     def invalidate_hint(self, key: PageKey) -> None:
211:         self._open()
212:         try:
213:             self.hint_queue.remove(key)
214:         except ValueError:
215:             pass
216:         if key in self.pending and key not in self.actual_demands:
217:             self.cancelled.add(key)
218:         if key in self.hint_resident:
219:             spec = self.resident.pop(key)
220:             self.resident_bytes -= spec.size_bytes
221:             self.hint_waste_bytes += spec.size_bytes
222:             self.hint_resident.remove(key)
223: 
224:     def _pinned(self, key: PageKey) -> bool:
225:         return any(lease.key == key for lease in self.leases.values())
226: 
227:     def _invalidate_speculative_pending(self) -> None:
228:         for key, ticket in tuple(self.pending.items()):
229:             if ticket.purpose == "hint" and key not in self.actual_demands:
230:                 self.invalidate_hint(key)
231: 
232:     def _evict_for(self, size: int) -> bool:
233:         if size > self.limits.weight_bytes:
234:             return False
235:         reserved = self.limits.fixed_model_bytes + self.resident_bytes + self.staging_bytes
236:         victims = []
237:         for key, spec in self.resident.items():
238:             if reserved + size <= self.limits.weight_bytes:
239:                 break
240:             if not self._pinned(key) and key not in self.actual_demands:
241:                 victims.append(key)
242:                 reserved -= spec.size_bytes
243:         if reserved + size > self.limits.weight_bytes:
244:             return False
245:         for key in victims:
246:             self.resident_bytes -= self.resident.pop(key).size_bytes
247:             self.hint_resident.discard(key)
248:         return True
249: 
250:     def next_io(self) -> IoTicket | None:
251:         """Reserve bytes before I/O; never admit a hint ahead of a queued demand."""
252:         self._accepting_work()
253:         self.check_waits()
254:         # A demand promoted from an in-flight hint is still waiting. New hints
255:         # must not take I/O slots until that actual demand has completed.
256:         waiting_on_io = any(key in self.actual_demands and key not in self.resident
257:                             for key in self.pending)
258:         if not self.demand_queue and waiting_on_io:
259:             return None
260:         source = self.demand_queue if self.demand_queue else self.hint_queue
261:         if not source:
262:             return None
263:         key = source[0]
264:         spec = self._spec(key)
265:         purpose = "demand" if source is self.demand_queue else "hint"
266:         if purpose == "demand":
267:             if spec.size_bytes > self.limits.staging_bytes:
268:                 self._stop("demand page exceeds staging budget")
269:             if spec.size_bytes > self.limits.weight_bytes - self.limits.fixed_model_bytes:
270:                 self._stop("demand page exceeds weight budget")
271:         if len(self.pending) >= self.limits.inflight_requests:
272:             if purpose == "demand":
273:                 self._invalidate_speculative_pending()
274:             return None
275:         if (spec.size_bytes > self.limits.staging_bytes or
276:                 self.staging_bytes + spec.size_bytes > self.limits.staging_bytes):
277:             if purpose == "demand" and spec.size_bytes > self.limits.staging_bytes:
278:                 self._stop("demand page exceeds staging budget")
279:             if purpose == "demand":
280:                 self._invalidate_speculative_pending()
281:             return None
282:         if not self._evict_for(spec.size_bytes):
283:             if purpose == "demand":
284:                 if spec.size_bytes > self.limits.weight_bytes - self.limits.fixed_model_bytes:
285:                     self._stop("demand page exceeds weight budget")
286:                 speculative = [pending_key for pending_key, pending_ticket in self.pending.items()
287:                                if pending_ticket.purpose == "hint" and pending_key not in self.actual_demands]
288:                 if speculative:
289:                     # Their reservations cannot be reclaimed until I/O completes.
290:                     # Drop their results and retry the real demand afterward.
291:                     for pending_key in speculative:
292:                         self.invalidate_hint(pending_key)
293:                     return None
294:                 # Remaining bytes are held by actual IO, GPU leases or actual
295:                 # resident demands. They may drain/finish; do not destroy a
296:                 # fit-capable waiting demand. Its fixed deadline bounds retries.
297:                 return None
298:             return None
299:         source.popleft()
300:         ticket = IoTicket(self.next_ticket, spec, purpose)
301:         self.next_ticket += 1
302:         self.pending[key] = ticket
303:         if purpose == "demand":
304:             self.wait_deadlines.pop(key, None)
305:         self.staging_bytes += spec.size_bytes
306:         return ticket

308:     def complete_io(self, ticket: IoTicket) -> None:
309:         """An adapter must call this only after the read and copy have completed."""
310:         current = self.pending.get(ticket.spec.key)
311:         if current is not ticket:
312:             raise PagerProtocolError("unmatched I/O completion")
313:         del self.pending[ticket.spec.key]
314:         self.wait_deadlines.pop(ticket.spec.key, None)
315:         self.staging_bytes -= ticket.spec.size_bytes
316:         if ticket.spec.key in self.cancelled and ticket.spec.key not in self.actual_demands:
317:             self.cancelled.remove(ticket.spec.key)
318:             if ticket.purpose == "hint":
319:                 self.hint_waste_bytes += ticket.spec.size_bytes
320:             self._finish_cancel_if_drained()
321:             return
322:         self.resident[ticket.spec.key] = ticket.spec
323:         self.resident_bytes += ticket.spec.size_bytes
324:         self.resident.move_to_end(ticket.spec.key)
325:         if ticket.purpose == "hint" and ticket.spec.key not in self.actual_demands:
326:             self.hint_resident.add(ticket.spec.key)
327: 
328:     def fail_io(self, ticket: IoTicket) -> None:
329:         """A synchronous failed read ended; release its reservation and stop."""
330:         current = self.pending.get(ticket.spec.key)
331:         if current is not ticket:
332:             raise PagerProtocolError("unmatched I/O failure")
333:         del self.pending[ticket.spec.key]
334:         self.staging_bytes -= ticket.spec.size_bytes
335:         self._stop("page I/O failed")
336: 
337:     def acquire(self, key: PageKey) -> int:
338:         """Return a lease only for a page demanded by actual model computation."""
339:         self._open()
340:         if key not in self.actual_demands or key not in self.resident:
341:             raise PagerProtocolError("page is not demanded and resident")
342:         self.resident.move_to_end(key)
343:         lease_id = _LeaseId(self.next_lease)
344:         self.next_lease += 1
345:         self.leases[lease_id] = Lease(key, handle=lease_id)
346:         return lease_id
347: 
348:     def _lease(self, lease_id: int) -> Lease:
349:         lease = self.leases.get(lease_id) if type(lease_id) is _LeaseId else None
350:         if lease is None or lease.handle is not lease_id:
351:             raise PagerProtocolError("unknown or foreign GPU lease")
352:         return lease
353: 
354:     def mark_gpu_done(self, lease_id: int) -> None:
355:         lease = self._lease(lease_id)
356:         if lease.gpu_done:
357:             raise PagerProtocolError("unknown or completed GPU lease")
358:         lease.gpu_done = True
359: 
360:     def release(self, lease_id: int) -> None:
361:         lease = self._lease(lease_id)
362:         if not lease.gpu_done:
363:             raise PagerProtocolError("release before GPU completion")
364:         del self.leases[lease_id]
365:         if self.closed:
366:             self._drain_unpinned()
367:         self._finish_cancel_if_drained()
368: 
369:     def finish_demand(self, key: PageKey) -> None:
370:         if key not in self.actual_demands or self._pinned(key) or key in self.pending or key in self.demand_queue:
371:             raise PagerProtocolError("demand has unfinished work")
372:         self.actual_demands.remove(key)
373:         self.wait_deadlines.pop(key, None)
374: 
375:     def cancel_request(self) -> None:
376:         """Drop queued hints/demands; in-flight buffers still await I/O completion."""
377:         self.cancel_draining = True
378:         self.demand_queue.clear()
379:         self.wait_deadlines.clear()
380:         self.hint_queue.clear()
381:         self.cancelled.update(self.pending)
382:         for key in tuple(self.hint_resident):
383:             self.invalidate_hint(key)
384:         self.actual_demands.clear()
385:         self._finish_cancel_if_drained()
386: 
387:     def accounting(self) -> dict[str, int]:
388:         return {"resident_bytes": self.resident_bytes,
389:                 "fixed_model_bytes": self.limits.fixed_model_bytes,
390:                 "staging_bytes": self.staging_bytes,
391:                 "reserved_weight_bytes": (self.limits.fixed_model_bytes +
392:                                           self.resident_bytes + self.staging_bytes),
393:                 "inflight_requests": len(self.pending),
394:                 "queued_demands": len(self.demand_queue),
395:                 "waiting_demands": len(self.wait_deadlines),
396:                 "queued_hints": len(self.hint_queue),
397:                 "gpu_leases": len(self.leases),
398:                 "invalidated_hint_bytes": self.hint_waste_bytes}

156:                     raise PagerProtocolError("short or invalid page read")

201:             cursor += span.length

207:         if self.borrows.get(borrow.lease_id) is not borrow:

210:     def gpu_done(self, borrow: PageBorrow) -> None:
211:         self._verify_borrow(borrow)

221:         for view in borrow.segments.values():

224:         del self.borrows[borrow.lease_id]

226:         self._reconcile()

229:         first_error = None

232:                 os.close(fd)
233:             except OSError as exc:
234:                 first_error = first_error or exc

264:         self.closed = True
265:         first_error = None
266:         try:
267:             self.pager.stop("fixture store closed")
268:         except PagerStop:
269:             pass
270:         except BaseException as exc:
271:             first_error = exc
272:         self.buffers.clear()
273:         try:
274:             self._close_fds()
275:         except BaseException as exc:
276:             first_error = first_error or exc

222:         for span in spec.spans:
223:             segment = target[cursor:cursor + span.length]
224:             self.files.readinto(span.filename, segment, span.offset)
225:             cursor += span.length

227:     def close(self) -> None:
228:         self.files.close()

231:         return self

237: def _verified_shard(files: VerifiedFiles, filename: str,
238:                     names: set[str]) -> tuple[dict, int]:
239:     prefix = files.read_metadata(filename, 0, 8)
240:     if len(prefix) != 8:
241:         raise CatalogError("short verified Safetensors prefix")
242:     length = struct.unpack("<Q", prefix)[0]
243:     if not 0 < length <= MAX_METADATA_BYTES - 8:
244:         raise CatalogError("unreasonable verified Safetensors header")
245:     header = json.loads(files.read_metadata(filename, 8, length))
246:     if type(header) is not dict:
247:         raise CatalogError("invalid verified Safetensors header")
248:     return inspect_shard_data(8 + length, header, files.file_sizes[filename], names)

251: def admit_checkpoint(root: Path, *, manifest_path: Path = MANIFEST,
252:                      ple_rows_per_page: int = 8192,
253:                      verified_files: VerifiedFiles | None = None) -> PageCatalog:
254:     manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
255:     if manifest.get("repo") != PINNED_REPO:
256:         raise CatalogError("unverified checkpoint revision")
257:     expected_files = {item["path"]: item["size_bytes"] for item in manifest["files"]}
258:     if verified_files is None:
259:         receipt = json.loads((root / "acquisition-receipt.json").read_text())
260:         if (receipt.get("complete") is not True or
261:                 receipt.get("revision") != manifest["revision"] or
262:                 receipt.get("repo") != manifest["repo"]):
263:             raise CatalogError("unverified checkpoint revision")
264:         if set(receipt.get("verified_files", [])) != set(expected_files):
265:             raise CatalogError("incomplete checkpoint receipt")
266:     if verified_files is not None:
267:         if (manifest.get("schema") != "pulsarmlx.qwen38.pinned-checkpoint/1" or
268:                 manifest.get("revision") != PINNED_REVISION or
269:                 root.is_symlink() or root.resolve(strict=True) != verified_files.root or
270:                 verified_files.entries != {entry["path"]: entry for entry in manifest["files"]} or
271:                 verified_files.file_sizes != expected_files):
272:             raise CatalogError("verified files do not match manifest and root")
273:     for filename, size in expected_files.items():
274:         if Path(filename).name != filename:
275:             raise CatalogError(f"unsafe or changed file: {filename}")
276:         if verified_files is not None:
277:             verified_files.check(filename)
278:         elif (root / filename).is_symlink() or (root / filename).stat().st_size != size:
279:             raise CatalogError(f"unsafe or changed file: {filename}")
280:     config = json.loads(verified_files.read_metadata("config.json") if verified_files else
281:                         (root / "config.json").read_text())
282:     index = json.loads(verified_files.read_metadata("model.safetensors.index.json") if verified_files else
283:                        (root / "model.safetensors.index.json").read_text())["weight_map"]
284:     expected_shards = {name for name in expected_files if name.endswith(".safetensors")}
285:     if set(index.values()) != expected_shards:
286:         raise CatalogError("index shard set disagrees with manifest")
287:     if config.get("model_type") != "qwen4_exp" or config.get("model_file") != "qwen4_exp.py":
288:         raise CatalogError("unexpected checkpoint architecture")
289:     text = config["text_config"]
290:     if (text["num_hidden_layers"], text["num_experts"],
291:             text["num_experts_per_tok"], text["split_ngram_parts"]) != (48, 512, 10, 128):
292:         raise CatalogError("unexpected checkpoint geometry")
293:     quant = config["quantization"]
294:     if (quant["bits"], quant["group_size"]) != (4, 64):
295:         raise CatalogError("unexpected checkpoint quantization")
296:     overrides = collections.Counter((item["bits"], item["group_size"])
297:                                     for item in quant.values() if isinstance(item, dict))
298:     if overrides != {(8, 64): 498, (4, 32): 128}:
299:         raise CatalogError("unexpected quantization overrides")
300:     tensors = {}
301:     for filename in sorted(set(index.values())):
302:         if filename not in expected_files or not filename.endswith(".safetensors"):
303:             raise CatalogError("index names an unadmitted shard")
304:         names = {name for name, listed in index.items() if listed == filename}
305:         header, data_start = (_verified_shard(verified_files, filename, names)
306:                               if verified_files else inspect_shard(root / filename, names))
307:         for name, item in header.items():
308:             tensors[name] = TensorRef(filename, data_start, item["dtype"], tuple(item["shape"]),
309:                                       *item["data_offsets"])
310:     ple_layers = {int(name.split(".layers.", 1)[1].split(".", 1)[0]) for name in tensors
311:                   if ".ple.ple_embedding.ngram_embedding.shard_" in name}
312:     if ple_layers != {1}:
313:         raise CatalogError("expected pinned PLE layer 1")
314:     catalog = PageCatalog(tensors, layers=48, experts=512, ple_layer=ple_layers.pop(),
315:                           ple_shards=128, ple_rows_per_page=ple_rows_per_page)
316:     if verified_files is not None:
317:         catalog._verified_files = verified_files
318:     return catalog

321: def _admit_checkpoint_bound_from_manifest(root: Path, *, manifest_path: Path,
322:                                           ple_rows_per_page: int = 8192) -> BoundCheckpoint:
323:     """Rehash all pinned files, then parse metadata through the retained handles."""
324:     files = open_pinned_files(root, manifest_path=manifest_path)
325:     try:
326:         catalog = admit_checkpoint(root, manifest_path=manifest_path,
327:                                    ple_rows_per_page=ple_rows_per_page,
328:                                    verified_files=files)
329:         return BoundCheckpoint(catalog, files, _BOUND_TOKEN)
330:     except BaseException as exc:
331:         try:
332:             files.close()
333:         except OSError as cleanup_error:
334:             if hasattr(exc, "add_note"):
335:                 exc.add_note(f"bound admission cleanup also failed: {cleanup_error}")
336:         raise
